title: Trace Assignment on Input Positions
statement: For every finite-state binary Turing machine $M$, every binary code for its optional states, every bit string $y$, and every index $j<|y|$, the trace assignment at position $j$ equals the bit of $y$ at that position (with a default value of false if the indexed bit is absent).
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet
A binary code is given for the optional states of $M$
replaced: For every machine, state code, input word $y$, and position $j < |y|$, the trace assignment at variable $j$ is the $j$-th bit of $y$.
